title: Pete Candoli's Superman stage act
summary: Pete flew down on a wire at the Paramount in a Superman suit before Apple Honey, while the comic Buddy Lester came out in the old baggy suit.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Pete -- well, he was called Superman. Why was that?

Well, he did a Superman tune, a number with us, and at theatres. It originally started out as a gag and it turned out to be quite a thing. And for instance, the Paramount Theatre he flew down on a wire from a very high balcony down to the stage.
And he came -- would land and go right into the bridge of 'Apple Honey', (inaudible), yeah. (Singing.)
Did he have a Superman suit and the whole --

Yes, his wife -- that wife at that season or period, made the Superman suit for him and then Buddy Lester, a comic, was working with the band at most theatres at that point, and when his wife made Pete a new Superman suit which was much finer and so on, the comic wound up with the old Superman suit. He's a little guy and Pete was quite a muscular young man, and so Pete would come down
the wire and do his Superman thing, and from the other side of the stage, this little guy would come out in the baggy Superman suit. It was a funny bit. He'd play a beat-up cornet.
Yeah. That was our show biz number.
Well, I've never heard a story about him, so I thought I'd ask you.
